Game Overview

In Santa Roll, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a festive adventure in Santa Roll, where you guide Santa through a candy-filled maze using simple controls. Master momentum and plan your moves to solve delightful puzzles, all while soaking in the cheerful Christmas spirit. Can you help Santa collect all the candy?
